vo.l01: Tonight... the living versus the dead. Somebody please bring a shovel and some garlic.
vo.l02: In the red corner... the zombie! Strictly on a brains-only diet, top speed two kilometers an hour, and it has not showered since the apocalypse started.
vo.l03: And in the blue corner... the human! Has watched every zombie movie twice and still opens the basement door to check that weird noise.
vo.l04: Fun fact: zombies feel no pain. They also feel no shame about that outfit.
vo.l05: Ohh! The zombie bites! That was not a punch, that was lunch!
vo.l06: But humans have something zombies lost a long time ago... a working brain.
vo.l08: Down goes the zombie! Dead again, for the second time!
vo.l10: Your winner... the living, breathing human!
vo.l11: The zombie is out cold, which, to be fair, is just its normal body temperature. Don't worry, it'll be back up by Monday.
vo.l12: Let's see that again... watch the uppercut. The jaw goes left, the arm goes right, and no brain shows up.

caption: Human vs. zombie 🧟🥊 Who wins the undead title fight? 👇
